notes: Sage grey-green board-sided condo over a red brick garage podium. Front edge 3: one round half-cylinder bay stack (storeys 1-3) at the south end, one large dark-framed window per storey over the garage, recessed brown garage door and a narrow service door in the brick base. Setback plane (edge 1) plain siding with windows. Flat roof, no cornice, dark frames. Tint pushed to a greener sage, round bay drawn with fewer wider facets so its curved windows read as panes, not slits. Wall now sage grey-green board siding. The south bay is a true half cylinder (projection = half its width) with full-height curved glazing in dark frames. Centre plane: one wide flush dark-framed window per storey, no sills. Base: whole ground storey in brick with a dark flush panel garage door and a narrow service door. Left (setback) wing: loggia balconies on each upper storey with solid light rails, planters and big glazed walls, recessed entry at its foot. Siding tint pushed greener (sage grey-green), left wing a cool light grey, brick a deeper red-brown. Brick podium a deep red-brown instead of salmon. The round bay is a solid sage siding drum (half-round, no curtain glass) with a punched dark-framed window on each curved facet per floor; a small dark fanlight panel at the parapet above the centre window stack; the garage is a dark brown panel door recessed under a brick lintel in the brick podium; the balcony wing is pale warm grey painted with white slab edges, clear guards with a dark steel rail, and its ground storey is plain wall (no brick) around a recessed entry. Garage a flat dark brown panel door (no roll-up ribs) under the brick lintel; the parapet fanlight kept to the sage block only. Rework B: frames, sashes and trim dark navy, glass dark blue; sage siding a touch deeper; the dark plaque under the parapet is gone and the top window of the flat column carries a half-round fanlight (archHeads, not repeated on the wing); brick base cut to 3.2 m with a soldier-course lintel over a recessed dark garage and a short dark side door (the grey column under the bay was the full-height stair door). Left set-back wing is pale grey siding with glazed bays behind grey slab balconies with thin bar rails. Not doable: a smooth cylinder with one curved window plus one flat window per storey (the kit bay draws one window per facet; rc 2 kept, 5 facets). Brick base at its true red; the dark garage door recessed 1 m. Not doable: one curved window per bow storey (the kit bay draws a sash per facet), a plain half-round fanlight (kit arch), the glazed corner bays of the left mass (kept as grey clapboard with slab balconies; it is inside this footprint). Window frames darker. Not drawable: smooth curved bow with one curved window per storey, recessed loggia notch. Red brick lintel plaque above the garage removed (only a brick header); left balcony wing gets solid parapets in place of picket bars. Wall tint is game-calibrated. Not doable: smooth round bow with one curved + one flat window per storey (kit draws sash per facet), herringbone paving. Tint lift (2026-10-02): wall tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k).
